name: noesis
title: Tryambakam Noesis
description: Read the current pattern in Raycast through pulse cadence, Noesis Engine lenses, Daily Witness, and authored next actions.
author: mage_narayan

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Tryambakam Noesis Access Key
preferences.description: Secure key for authenticated Selemene Engine requests. It never grants access to the separate admin domain.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Noesis Base URL
preferences.description: Optional fallback API URL when onboarding has not stored one yet.

preferences.name: witnessUrl
preferences.title: Daily Witness API URL
preferences.description: Trusted Witness gateway URL used only when the execution route preference is set to Witness.

preferences.name: executionRoute
preferences.title: Execution Route
preferences.description: Selemene Engine is canonical. Witness Gateway remains an explicit compatibility route during migration.

preferences.name: readingHistoryLimit
preferences.title: Reading History Cache
preferences.description: Maximum number of reading rows to keep in the local SQLite cache.

preferences.name: cacheRawPayloads
preferences.title: Store Raw Payloads
preferences.label: Keep full raw result JSON in the local cache
preferences.description: Keep full raw result JSON in the local cache for operator debugging. When off, Raycast stores only minimized payloads.

preferences.name: pulseMode
preferences.title: Pulse Fallback Mode
preferences.description: Choose which source pulse should drive the menu bar when the current NadaBrahman remedy is unavailable.

commands.name: dashboard

commands.name: engines
commands.title: Engines
commands.description: Operator workbench for Noesis Engine lenses, direct runs, and cached reading context

commands.name: workflows
commands.title: Workflows

commands.name: readings
commands.title: Readings

commands.name: profile
commands.title: Ritual Defaults

commands.name: daily-witness

commands.name: developer-tools
commands.title: Developer Tools
